title: UK population estimates
description: ONS mid-year population estimates for the UK and its constituent countries, with the detailed annual back series by local authority from 2011 and the long historical series from 1838. Published on the UK-wide release, which lags the England and Wales release in the sibling 'england-wales' dataset.
